Hi Maya — thanks for the quick packet. I reviewed the SOW and W9. Short answer: we can consider an invoice-only onboarding for a 90-day pilot, but Procurement/Finance requires an exception ladder and a few safeguards before we flip the switch.

Quick asks from our side so we can move this to Procurement:
- Confirm billing owner and billing email on your invoices.
- Maximum single-invoice cap you’re comfortable with (we typically require a cap for invoice-only pilots).
- Primary contact for escalations and technical owner for the pilot.

Proposed temporary rules (what I’ll ask Procurement to approve):
- Invoice-only for 90 days or up to $10k total (whichever comes first).
- Single invoice cap: $5k. Anything above triggers procurement re-review.
- 30 net payment terms; invoices to finance@redwood.com with billing reference: SynapseAI-Pilot-DEAL-8421.
- We will require a basic risk checklist (I’ll attach our assessment template).

If that looks good I’ll route to Priya in Procurement for formal exception and attach your SOW/W9. Can you confirm the cap and contacts?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference

Marcus / Maya — looping in Procurement ops. I reviewed the SOW and the ask. We can approve an invoice-only onboarding under the following conditional approval ladder:

Procurement exception ladder (recommended):
- Tier 1 (auto-approve): total exposure <= $10k, single invoice <= $5k, SOW and W9 on file, basic AML/KYC checks passed. Approver: Procurement ops (me).
- Tier 2 (manager review): total exposure > $10k and <= $25k or single invoice > $5k <= $15k. Approver: Procurement Manager + Finance notification (Naomi).
- Tier 3 (exec + legal): any exposure > $25k or commercial terms deviating from standard (longer payment terms, prepayments). Approver: Head of Procurement + Legal.

Operational conditions we require for Tier 1 onboarding:
- Redlined/acknowledged SOW (signed by Synapse billing owner).
- Synapse agrees to single-invoice cap of $5k and total pilot cap of $10k.
- Invoices sent to finance@redwood.com with reference DEAL-8421.
- Procurement will perform a quick risk assessment; see attached (redwood_risk_assessment_Synapse.xlsx).
- Finance will create a temporary vendor record flagged as "invoice-only pilot" with 90-day expiry.

Maya — if you confirm the cap and the billing contact I’ll open ticket PROC-8421 and route for Tier 1 approval. Naomi, please confirm you’re OK to be looped for Manager review if totals creep.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
